is_anopheles.evidence: Larvae of Anopheles gambiae sensu lato mosquitoes were collected in 12 sentinel sites throughout Rwanda (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Seven hundred and twenty-five (134 An. gambiae s.s. and 591 An. arabiensis) mosquitoes collected in 2011 and 2013 were genotyped for kdr-east (L1014S) (Page 5, kdr Genotypes).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on page 7 lists exact genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis across seven sentinel sites, with 725 total specimens genotyped.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from field breeding sites in 12 sentinel sites across Rwanda in 2011 and 2013 and reared to adults (Page 2, Mosquito collection).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research paper describing nationwide field surveys of vector composition, insecticide resistance, and kdr genotype frequencies in Rwanda (Page 1, Abstract).

sub_country_location.evidence: Sampling took place in 12 specific sentinel sites across Rwanda: Busoro, Mbuga, Karambi, Rukara, Mimuri, Bukora, Mareba, Mashesha, Kivumu, Mubuga, Kibogora, and Kicukiro (Page 2, Study area and Fig. 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field surveys and mosquito collections took place in 2011 and 2013 (Page 1, Abstract).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine nationwide IR monitoring conducted by the National Malaria Control Programme of Rwanda; original dataset published in this paper.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, sample sizes, and bioassay results are provided in full within Tables 1-5 of the main manuscript.

assessment.summary: This primary study reports on insecticide susceptibility and kdr-east (Vgsc L995S) frequencies in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles arabiensis collected across sentinel sites in Rwanda in 2011 and 2013. A total of 725 mosquitoes (134 An. gambiae s.s. and 591 An. arabiensis) were genotyped for the L1014S mutation, with complete genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) provided per site.
